svg.title: The path of one question
svg.desc: The question is embedded and looked up in the semantic cache. On a miss, the top five chunks are retrieved from Chroma and checked for relevance. In scope, the agent loop lets the model call tools until it writes the answer, streaming tokens to the browser. The SOURCES line is hidden and turned into source chips, the answer is cached if no tool was used, and a done event ends the stream.
svg.text: What happens to one question in /ask/stream
Row 1 decides whether to answer at all. Row 2 writes the answer and streams it.
agent loop: every model call is streamed
A turn with no tool request is the answer. Maximum 6 turns, then a safe message.
While the loop runs, trail steps, product cards and answer tokens are sent to the browser as they happen.
